messages:
Raj: Quick RFC follow-up: propose two-part precision artifacts: immutable 'capabilities' + ephemeral 'runtime_override' hint. Keeps model/hardware guarantees separated from operator control.

Jules: Short version?

Raj: Capabilities = signed blob (supported lanes, quality anchors, canonical fallbacks). Runtime_override = per-request or per-account hint (canary pin, emergency opt-out).

Anika: How do we keep current per-layer calibs?

Marta: Adapter at deploy-time: expand capabilities into per-layer profile for runtime to consume. Cache results and version the adapter.

Chris: Telemetry must track lane deltas (deg_score, tokenwise SNR) and support shadow sampling.

Anika: Ops needs ability to bump shadow sample rate per-tenant during rollouts.

Sam: Store capabilities as content-addressed blobs (sha256). Human-friendly names allowed but not canonical.

Raj: API example: POST /generate { precision: "auto" | "fp8" | "int8", quality_budget: "0.5%" } and an account-level safe_mode flag to disable lowbit lanes.

Marta: QA: add smoke prompts checking hallucination and quality regression across lanes.

Chris: Canary plan: 72h shadowing then progressive ramp 1/5/25/50/100% with auto-rollback if deg_score or latency breach thresholds. SRE to own.

Anika: I'll build dashboards and alerts for deg_score by lane and cohort drift.

Raj: Owners: Raj (adapter+migration), Anika (telemetry), SRE/Chris (canary), Sam (API ergonomics). I'll open the adapter PR by EOD Wed.

Jules: Sounds good. Anything else?

Sam: Add audit logs for any ops_override or customer_hint usage.

Marta: +1, will prepare QA smoke pack.

Raj: Great, will post PR link here when ready.
